2) Remit address: is 1217 Ridgeway Ave the billing address to print on the PO, or is the remit flow to invoices@alpinelabs.com via your portal? We can set the PO to the physical address and route invoices to the mailbox; want to be explicit.

Once you confirm (1)–(3), Kim will map the vendor to our ERP with the vendor code and PO routing. Karthik, please note: vendor classification should be "Goods & Services — External" and default PO hold off for first invoice until 30 days of validation.

Jordan — can you confirm by EOD tomorrow (9/2)? If easier, a single reply with the three confirmations is fine.
